ceu: ✦ The sextile between the Moon and the Sun at {H:1809177851000}

t: A day for prayer, meditation or a simple walk on your own. The peace you find today stays with you.

The sextile between the Moon and the Sun brings together, in your favour, your inner life and money: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, the Sun brings willpower and visibility. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Sleep a little longer, if you can.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.

The sextile between the Moon and the Sun brings together, in your favour, friendships and your image: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, the Sun brings willpower and visibility. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Do a friend a favour without expecting anything in return.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.

The sextile between the Moon and the Sun brings together, in your favour, your career and your inner life: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, the Sun brings willpower and visibility. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Say no to a task that is not yours.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.

The sextile between the Moon and the Sun brings together, in your favour, your horizons and friendships: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, the Sun brings willpower and visibility. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Accept an invitation that is different from usual.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.

The sextile between the Moon and the Sun brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your career: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, the Sun brings willpower and visibility. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Speak frankly about a matter you keep avoiding.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.

The sextile between the Moon and the Sun brings together, in your favour, relationships and your horizons: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, the Sun brings willpower and visibility. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Give way on something small to gain on something big.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of routine and health. Organising the day is the best way to make the most of it.

The sextile between the Moon and the Sun brings together, in your favour, routine and intimacy: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, the Sun brings willpower and visibility. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Book that test or check-up you keep putting off.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.

The sextile between the Moon and the Sun brings together, in your favour, romance and relationships: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, the Sun brings willpower and visibility. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Allow yourself a sweet or a treat without guilt.

t: With the Moon in your house of roots, old memories may return. Welcome them without getting stuck in them.

The sextile between the Moon and the Sun brings together, in your favour, family and routine: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, the Sun brings willpower and visibility. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Tidy a drawer or a corner of the house that bothers you.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: The Moon livens up short trips and contact with siblings, neighbours and colleagues. A day on the move.

The sextile between the Moon and the Sun brings together, in your favour, conversations and romance: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, the Sun brings willpower and visibility. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Take a different route on your usual way.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: Today's emotions run through your wallet and through what you consider yours. Protect what you have built, without closing yourself off.

The sextile between the Moon and the Sun brings together, in your favour, money and family: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, the Sun brings willpower and visibility. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Treat yourself to a small comfort that costs almost nothing.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.

The sextile between the Moon and the Sun brings together, in your favour, your image and conversations: the Moon brings emotion and intuition, the Sun brings willpower and visibility. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Wear a colour you really love and notice how it changes your mood.
